_note: 學習路徑內容第24批 #3／6：易混形容詞副詞 confusable pairs（eng.t_adv.adjadv.confusable-pairs，學測級／高階）。hard（副詞＝努力地、用力地：work hard）vs hardly（副詞＝幾乎不：hardly ever）；late（副詞＝遲、晚：arrive late）vs lately（副詞＝最近：Have you ... lately?）；near（接近）vs nearly（副詞＝幾乎、差一點：nearly fell）。誘答鎖『以對立或無關字義替換／hardly 位置誤置於動詞後』等唯一正解；位置誘答以『通常位於主要動詞前』framing 不過度宣稱。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix cfp_）。

units.can_do: 我能分辨 hard（努力地）與 hardly（幾乎不）、late（遲）與 lately（最近）、near（接近）與 nearly（幾乎），依語意選對字。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'hard' as an adverb means 'with great effort' and goes after the verb: 'She works hard.' It also keeps its adjective meaning 'difficult / solid'.
claims.verification_ref: hard 當副詞＝努力地/用力地、位於動詞後（She works hard）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'hardly' means 'almost not' and usually comes before the main verb: 'He hardly speaks'; 'I can hardly see.' It is a different word from 'hard', not its adverb form.
claims.verification_ref: hardly＝幾乎不，通常位於主要動詞前（He hardly speaks；I can hardly see）；與 hard 是不同的字；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'late' (adverb) means 'not on time / after the expected time': 'He arrived late.' 'lately' means 'recently' and is often used with the present perfect: 'Have you seen any good films lately?'
claims.verification_ref: late（副詞）＝遲/晚（arrived late）；lately＝最近，常搭現在完成式（Have you seen ... lately）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'nearly' means 'almost': 'I nearly missed the bus' (= I almost missed it). It is different from 'near' (= close to).
claims.verification_ref: nearly＝幾乎/差一點（I nearly missed the bus）；與 near（接近）不同；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 'hard' as an adverb means 'with effort' and goes after the verb (work hard). 'hardly' is a different word meaning 'almost not' and goes before the main verb (He hardly speaks).
teach.zh_hint: hard 當副詞是『努力地』，放在動詞後面（work hard）；hardly 是另一個字，意思是『幾乎不』，放在主要動詞前面（He hardly speaks）。

teach.body: She works hard, but she hardly earns enough.
teach.zh_hint: 她工作很努力，卻幾乎賺不夠。work hard＝努力；hardly＝幾乎不。

teach.body: 'late' (adverb) means 'not on time' (He arrived late). 'lately' means 'recently' and often goes with the present perfect (Have you seen her lately?).
teach.zh_hint: late（副詞）是『遲、晚』（He arrived late）；lately 是『最近』，常和現在完成式一起用（Have you seen her lately?）。

teach.body: The train arrived late, but I haven't been late lately.
teach.zh_hint: 火車誤點了，但我最近都沒遲到。late＝遲到；lately＝最近。

teach.body: 'nearly' means 'almost' (I nearly fell). Do not confuse it with 'near' (= close to).
teach.zh_hint: nearly 是『幾乎、差一點』（I nearly fell）；別和 near（接近、靠近）搞混。

teach.body: I nearly missed the bus this morning.
teach.zh_hint: 我今天早上差一點錯過公車。nearly＝幾乎、差一點。

practice.stem: 選正確：He studied all night; he ____ slept at all.（幾乎沒睡）

distractor_rationales.hard: hard＝努力地/用力地，這裡要表達『幾乎沒睡』，應用 hardly。
distractor_rationales.lately: lately＝最近，與『幾乎沒睡』語意不合。
distractor_rationales.nearly: nearly＝幾乎（差一點做某事），此處要搭 at all 表『幾乎不…』用 hardly。

practice.stem: 選正確：You must work ____ to pass the exam.（努力用功）

distractor_rationales.hardly: hardly＝幾乎不，意思正好相反（work hardly 會變成幾乎不工作）。
distractor_rationales.nearly: nearly＝幾乎，與『努力用功』語意不合。
distractor_rationales.lately: lately＝最近，與『努力用功』語意不合。

practice.stem: 選正確：Have you seen any good films ____?（最近）

distractor_rationales.late: late＝遲/晚，不是『最近』；『最近』用 lately。
distractor_rationales.hardly: hardly＝幾乎不，與『最近』語意不合。

practice.feedback: seen any good films lately：lately＝最近。

practice.stem: 選正確：The road was icy, so I ____ fell over.（差一點跌倒）

distractor_rationales.hardly: hardly＝幾乎不，這裡要表達『差一點跌倒』（幾乎跌倒），用 nearly。
distractor_rationales.near: near＝接近，不用來修飾動詞 fell 表『差一點』；要用 nearly。
distractor_rationales.lately: lately＝最近，與『差一點跌倒』語意不合。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（他幾乎不說話）

hard（努力地）通常放在動詞後面（works hard）；表『幾乎不』要用 hardly，且放在主要動詞前。
lately＝最近，語意不合『幾乎不說話』，也不這樣擺放。
nearly＝幾乎（差一點做某事），語意不合『幾乎不說話』。

practice.feedback: He hardly speaks：hardly 放在主要動詞前，表幾乎不。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: She works hard but hardly earns enough.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：works hard（努力）、hardly earns（幾乎不）、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。重音落在對比的副詞、句尾下收。

lines.text: She works hard but hardly earns enough.
lines.intonation: hard 與 hardly 對比重音、enough 句尾下收

lines.text: I nearly missed the bus this morning.
lines.intonation: nearly 重音、morning 句尾下收
